verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows support no-code conditional logic and risk-based routing (auto-tag high-risk inquiries, run additional reports on conditions, multiple trigger types), and Inquiry/Dynamic Flow Templates let ops configure screens, verifications, decisioning, and theming without engineering changes. However, evidence never explicitly addresses country-specific requirement configuration or confirms these changes deploy without engineering involvement. Missing for 10: explicit country/jurisdiction-based rule configuration, and confirmation that template/workflow edits go live without engineering deploys.
